title: June Jones dies at 73: Pioneer coach produced innovative offenses at SMU, Hawaii and the NFL's Atlanta Falcons

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: June Jones dies at 73: Pioneer coach produced innovative offenses at SMU, Hawaii and the NFL's Atlanta Falcons
sources.description: A pioneer of the run-and-shoot offense, Jones engineered historic turnarounds at Hawaii and SMU while mentoring record-setting passers Timmy Chang and Colt Brennan
